messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High model-load failure rate on pool-gamma: 25 failures in 5m. Symptoms: OOM during init, repeated deserializing errors, compile-timeouts. Auto-escalation to #incidents.
devon_oncall: Ack. I'm digging in. Pulling the last 20 logs.
mike_sre: Seeing repeated `cudaMalloc` OOMs from loader process on node gpu-21 and gpu-23. Paging spikes at the same time. Logs:
```
[init] load_model shard-67: deserializing artifact... error: unexpected EOF during gzip inflate
[init] compile kernels: timeout 120s
runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
```
anna_prod: Any customer-facing impact? CS reporting elevated 503s for model gen endpoint in us-west-2.
devon_oncall: Yep — prometheus shows 1.3% 5xx for that route, correlated with node restarts. Retrying gives 200s mostly but some timeouts.
sam_runtime: Looks like the load attempts are hammering the node. We're in a hot-loop: loader retries immediately after failure which triggers more paging and node swap.
lee_infra: Node-level messages: kubelet restarted container on gpu-21 4x in last 8m. dmesg shows gpu driver resets: `NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus`.
mike_sre: Hypothesis: corrupted artifact or truncated tar -> deserializer hits EOF -> loader spins -> memory fragmentation + repeated compiles -> OOM + driver reset.
devon_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Pause new model loads to pool-gamma via routing group; 2) Force fallback model (smaller quantized) for affected route; 3) Drain and reprovision gpu-21/gpu-23; 4) Increase init timeout and add exponential backoff to loader.
anna_prod: I'll draft a short customer note: "brief elevated errors for model X in us-west-2, mitigation in progress, minimal sustained impact". Tagging support.
sam_runtime: Executing change: disabling hot-loads on pool-gamma now -- applying traffic policy to route requests to pool-beta by capacity. Command:
```
redwoodctl route set --route /v1/gen-model-x --policy prefer:pool-beta --no-new-loads
```
lee_infra: Draining gpu-21 and gpu-23 via kubectl cordon + evict. Kube command in progress.
mike_sre: Evicted pods. Restarting node drivers after drain. Also nuked cached artifacts on those nodes to force fresh fetch.
devon_oncall: Patching loader service to add jittered backoff and raise compile timeout from 120s -> 300s. Rolling restart on loader fleet.
anna_prod: CS notified and posted interim message. Will update when we confirm steady state.
sam_runtime: Confirmed: fallback quantized model active for /v1/gen-model-x. Error rate dropped from 1.3% to 0.12% over 6 minutes.
lee_infra: Node health looks stable after driver restart. No further GPU panics in last 8m.
mike_sre: Found an artifact with truncated checksum on s3 partial object `artifacts/model-x/shard-67.tar.gz` at 2026-02-25T02:14Z. Triggered reupload from CI—validating checksums now.
devon_oncall: Next steps: 1) Rehydrate artifact store and run integrity scan; 2) Add artifact checksum verification during warmup with early fail (no hot-loop); 3) Deploy loader change (backoff + limited retries). I'll open follow-up RFC for longer term: disable parallel shard loads by default for large models.
anna_prod: ETA for full resolution?
devon_oncall: Rehydration+scan ~30m, then controlled re-enable of pool-gamma with canary traffic. I'll post when we toggle.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity reduced to S2. Services stable. No customer-facing degradation after fallback. Postmortem owner assigned: devon_oncall.
devon_oncall: Closing channel for now. If anything flares, @here re-open thread. Thanks all. :heart:
